definitionEn: able to last a long time without breaking, wearing out or weakening
situation: Describing materials, products or agreements that stay strong and keep working for many years despite heavy use.

examples.text: Hiking boots should be made of [[durable]] leather that can survive years of rain and mud.
After years of fighting, both sides are hoping for a [[durable]] peace rather than another short ceasefire.
Sales of [[durable]] goods such as fridges and cars usually fall when people are worried about their jobs.

texts: My old laptop was cheap but surprisingly [[durable]].
Negotiators are looking for a [[durable]] solution, not a quick fix.
Oak is a [[durable]] wood that can last for centuries.

badCollocation.noteRu: Durable — прочный, долговечный. О долгой встрече или поездке говорят long или lengthy: a lengthy meeting.

collocationTask.prompt: ___ goods such as cars and washing machines
collocationTask.explanationRu: Товары длительного пользования — durable goods. Lasting говорят о мире или впечатлении, solid — о твёрдом, firm — о решении или хватке.

nuance.text: Work trousers should be made of a [[durable]] fabric that survives daily washing.
nuance.explanationRu: Durable — о вещах и материалах, которые долго не изнашиваются. Lasting — о впечатлении, эффекте или мире (a lasting impression); lasting fabric звучит неестественно.

reverse.text: Her first piano teacher made a [[lasting]] impression on her.
reverse.explanationRu: Впечатление, которое остаётся надолго, — a lasting impression. Durable описывает прочные вещи, а не впечатления.

fixIt.text: The garden chairs are made of a [[long-term]] plastic that survives frost and summer heat.
fixIt.explanationRu: Long-term — долгосрочный (план, контракт). О прочном, долговечном материале говорят durable.

wordFormation.text: Reviewers praised the [[durability]] of the new laptop, which survived several falls onto a stone floor.

reply.context: A colleague asks in a chat: "Should we order the cheap office chairs or the more expensive ones?"
options: The cheap ones. They're more durable, so they'll break quickly and we can buy new ones.
The expensive ones. They're more durable, so we won't have to replace them next year.
I would recommend the expensive option on the grounds of its superior durability characteristics.
reply.explanationRu: Durable — долговечный, поэтому менять стулья не придётся. Первый вариант путает смысл: прочное не ломается быстро. Третий звучит как отчёт, а не сообщение коллеге.

definitionEn: the way people in a group behave towards and influence each other
senseNote: Существительное о характере отношений в группе (group dynamics), а не прилагательное «энергичный».
situation: Talking about how the members of a team, family or class relate to one another and who influences whom.

examples.text: The new manager noticed an unhealthy [[dynamic]] in the team, where two people made every decision.
Therapists often ask couples to describe the [[dynamic]] of their relationship: who leads, who follows, who gives in.
Office parties are a good place to observe the hidden [[dynamics]] of a company: who talks to whom, and who is ignored.

texts: The [[dynamic]] between the two lead actors makes the film work.
Working from home has changed the [[dynamic]] in many families.
There's an odd power [[dynamic]] in their friendship.

badCollocation.noteRu: «Положительная динамика продаж» — это an upward trend или growth in sales. Dynamic говорят об отношениях людей в группе.

collocationTask.prompt: the power ___ between a boss and an intern
collocationTask.explanationRu: Power dynamic — расстановка сил в отношениях. Dynamism — энергичность, movement и motion — движение; с power в этом смысле они не сочетаются.

nuance.text: Our coach spent the first week studying the [[dynamic]] of the team before changing anything.
nuance.explanationRu: Dynamic — то, как люди в группе влияют друг на друга. Trend — направление изменения цифр (рост, спад); к отношениям в команде не подходит.

reverse.text: Analysts noticed a clear upward [[trend]] in online sales this year.
reverse.explanationRu: Рост или падение показателей — trend. «Положительная динамика продаж» — калька: dynamic говорят об отношениях людей.

fixIt.text: Psychologists study group [[dynamism]] to understand why some teams work better than others.
fixIt.explanationRu: Dynamism — энергичность, напор. То, как люди в группе взаимодействуют, называется group dynamics.

reply.context: At a team meeting, your manager asks: "How are things going since the two new designers joined?"
options: Great — sales have a very positive dynamic, up ten percent this month.
The dynamics of personnel integration are proceeding within expected parameters.
Really well. They've changed the dynamic in a good way: people share ideas more openly now.
reply.explanationRu: Верен третий ответ: dynamic — характер отношений в команде. Рост продаж — это growth или trend, а второй вариант звучит как канцелярский отчёт.

definitionEn: wanting very much to do or have something, often impatiently
senseNote: Главное здесь — конструкции eager to do something и eager for something: «очень хочется, не терпится».
situation: Describing someone who really wants to do or get something and can hardly wait for it to happen.

examples.text: New employees are often [[eager]] to impress, so they volunteer for every project.
Fans waited outside the studio all night, [[eager]] for news about the band's next album.
My evening class is full of [[eager]] learners who stay behind to ask questions.

texts: The interns are [[eager]] to learn and never complain.
Investors are [[eager]] for signs that inflation is slowing.
He seemed a little too [[eager]] to agree with the boss.

badCollocation.noteRu: Об увлечении говорят keen on или into: keen on football. После eager нужен to do или for something: eager to play.

collocationTask.explanationRu: Eager to please — очень стараться угодить. Greedy — жадный, thirsty — испытывающий жажду, curious — любопытный; с to please они не сочетаются.

nuance.text: The volunteers were so [[eager]] to start that they arrived an hour early.
nuance.explanationRu: Eager — очень хочется, не терпится. Willing — просто готов сделать, если нужно, без особого желания; приход на час раньше показывает именно нетерпение.

reverse.text: I'm not a fan of camping, but I'm [[willing]] to try it once for you.
reverse.explanationRu: Человек лишь соглашается, хотя сам не хочет: это willing. Eager значило бы, что ему не терпится, а это противоречит началу фразы.

fixIt.text: The new graduates were [[greedy]] for experience and volunteered for every difficult project.
fixIt.explanationRu: Greedy — жадный в плохом смысле (о деньгах, еде). Если человек очень хочет опыта или знаний, говорят eager for.

wordFormation.text: The final season of the series is [[eagerly]] awaited by fans around the world.

reply.context: Your new manager emails: "We'd like you to lead the training project next month. Are you interested?"
options: Absolutely — I'm eager to get started. Could we meet this week to discuss the details?
Absolutely — but I'm quite eager at the moment, so maybe someone else could lead it?
Yeah, super eager, count me in, mate!
reply.explanationRu: Eager to do something — очень хотеть взяться за дело, поэтому верен первый ответ. Во втором eager ошибочно значит «занят», третий слишком фамильярен для нового начальника.

definitionEn: the profit that a company makes during a particular period
senseNote: Выбрано деловое значение — прибыль компании (quarterly earnings), а не заработок одного человека.
situation: Business news reports how much profit a company made over the last three months or the last year.

examples.text: The company's [[earnings]] rose by twelve percent last quarter, so shareholders will get a bigger dividend.
Despite record sales, the firm's [[earnings]] were hit hard by rising energy costs.
"Did the airline have a good year?" "Not really — its [[earnings]] fell for the third year running."

texts: Strong [[earnings]] pushed the share price to a record high.
The bank will publish its annual [[earnings]] on Friday.
Higher fuel costs have eaten into the shipping firm's [[earnings]].

badCollocation.noteRu: Доходы государства от налогов — tax revenue. Earnings — прибыль компании или заработок человека.

collocationTask.explanationRu: Earnings per share — прибыль на одну акцию, ключевой показатель компании. Wages и salaries — зарплаты работников, incomes — доходы людей.

nuance.text: Sales were huge, but after paying for staff and energy, the company's [[earnings]] were tiny.
nuance.explanationRu: Revenue — вся выручка до вычета расходов. Earnings — прибыль, которая остаётся после них; раз расходы уже вычли, нужен earnings.

reverse.text: The shop's [[revenues]] were high, but after rent and salaries it made almost no profit.
reverse.explanationRu: Большая выручка при почти нулевой прибыли — это revenues. Earnings и есть прибыль, поэтому фраза стала бы противоречивой.

fixIt.text: Thanks to cheaper energy, the supermarket chain's [[salaries]] doubled and its share price hit a record high.
fixIt.explanationRu: Salaries — зарплаты сотрудников, рост акций от них не зависит. Прибыль компании — earnings.

wordFormation.text: The group's [[earnings]] beat expectations for the fifth quarter in a row.

reply.context: A colleague messages you: "Why did our share price jump this morning?"
options: Because my earnings went up after my promotion last month.
The quarterly earnings came out, and they were much better than analysts expected.
Consequent upon the publication of earnings, equity valuations appreciated.
reply.explanationRu: Earnings здесь — квартальная прибыль компании, от неё зависит цена акций. Личный заработок тут ни при чём, а третий ответ звучит как канцелярский отчёт.

rewrite.original: The company made much more profit this year than last year.
rewrite.frame: The company's ____ much higher this year than last year.
rewrite.explanationRu: Прибыль компании — earnings; слово во множественном числе, поэтому were.

definitionEn: a relaxed, comfortable state in which you feel free from worry
senseNote: Выбрано значение «спокойствие, непринуждённость» (at ease, put someone at ease), а не «лёгкость» (with ease).
situation: Describing how relaxed and comfortable someone feels with other people or in an unfamiliar place.

examples.text: A good interviewer starts with a few friendly questions to put candidates at [[ease]].
Although she didn't know anyone at the party, she seemed completely at [[ease]].
After years of city noise, he found a new sense of [[ease]] in the quiet village.

texts: He always feels ill at [[ease]] in formal suits.
The nurse's warm smile put the nervous patient at [[ease]].
I never feel completely at [[ease]] speaking in front of big audiences.

badCollocation.noteRu: По-английски говорят просто feel at ease: русское «чувствовать себя» не переводится как feel myself.

collocationTask.explanationRu: Помочь людям расслабиться — put someone at ease. At rest и at peace описывают покой, но с put someone не употребляются, а at calm не говорят вовсе.

nuance.text: The coach's calm, friendly manner put the young players at [[ease]] before the final.
nuance.explanationRu: Put someone at ease — помочь расслабиться заранее. Relief — облегчение, когда тревога уже позади; put someone at relief не говорят.

reverse.text: Everyone breathed a sigh of [[relief]] when the plane finally landed.
reverse.explanationRu: Облегчение после страха — relief (a sigh of relief). Ease — спокойное состояние, a sigh of ease не говорят.

fixIt.text: Many people feel ill at [[comfort]] when they have to speak in front of strangers.
fixIt.explanationRu: Устойчивое выражение — ill at ease (не в своей тарелке). Со словом comfort такого сочетания нет.

rewrite.original: The friendly nurse helped the nervous patient to relax.
rewrite.frame: The friendly nurse put the nervous patient ____.
rewrite.explanationRu: Устойчивое выражение: put someone at ease — помочь человеку расслабиться.

definitionEn: behaving or looking in an unusual, slightly strange but usually harmless way
situation: Describing a person whose habits, clothes or ideas are unusual and a little strange, often in a charming way.

examples.text: My [[eccentric]] neighbour walks his cat on a lead and wears a top hat to the supermarket.
The professor was brilliant but [[eccentric]], often teaching in slippers and forgetting which day it was.
The hotel's decoration is wonderfully [[eccentric]]: antique furniture, neon lights and stuffed birds in every room.

texts: The film is about an [[eccentric]] inventor who lives in a lighthouse.
His taste in music is a little [[eccentric]].
She has an [[eccentric]] habit of reading novels from the last page.

badCollocation.noteRu: Eccentric говорят о людях, их привычках и вкусах. Странный звук или запах — a strange или odd noise.

collocationTask.prompt: a ___ eccentric uncle who talks to his plants
collocationTask.explanationRu: С eccentric естественно звучат slightly, a little или highly. Heavily, strongly и badly с этим прилагательным не сочетаются.

nuance.text: Our [[eccentric]] landlord keeps a pet goose in the garden and talks to it about the news.
nuance.explanationRu: Eccentric — чудаковатый, со странностями. Extravagant — расточительный или слишком роскошный; русское «экстравагантный» о человеке обычно передаётся словом eccentric.

reverse.text: They spent an [[extravagant]] amount of money on flowers for the wedding.
reverse.explanationRu: Слишком большие траты — extravagant. Eccentric описывает странности характера, а не суммы денег.

fixIt.text: My [[eclectic]] aunt wears a fur hat in July and talks to her houseplants every morning.
fixIt.explanationRu: Eclectic — смешанный, составленный из разных стилей (вкус, коллекция). Человек со странностями — eccentric.

wordFormation.text: The writer's [[eccentricity]] made him a favourite with journalists and talk-show hosts.

reply.context: A colleague asks you: "So what's the new head of design like?"
options: Nice, but a bit eccentric — she always arrives on time and follows every rule.
The individual in question exhibits a moderate level of eccentricity.
Nice, but a bit eccentric — she brings her tortoise to work on Fridays.
reply.explanationRu: Eccentric — со странностями, и черепаха в офисе — как раз такой случай. Пунктуальность и правила — признаки обычного человека, а второй вариант звучит как протокол.

definitionEn: to repeat or support an opinion that someone else has already expressed
senseNote: Выбрано переносное значение — повторять чужую мысль, соглашаясь с ней (echo someone's concerns), а не звуковое эхо.
situation: Saying the same thing that another person has already said, to show that you share their view.

examples.text: Agreeing with every word, the other speakers [[echoed]] her concerns about staff shortages.
Tom never has ideas of his own; he just [[echoes]] whatever the boss says in meetings.
The new report [[echoes]] earlier studies, again finding that most teenagers sleep too little.

texts: Many parents [[echoed]] the teacher's call for shorter school days.
Her words [[echoed]] what I had been thinking for months.
The union leader's complaints were [[echoed]] by staff across the country.

badCollocation.noteRu: Echo — переходный глагол без предлога: echo the manager's words. «Вторить кому-то» не переводится как echo to someone.

collocationTask.prompt: to ___ the concerns of many parents
collocationTask.explanationRu: Повторить и поддержать чужие опасения — echo someone's concerns. Sound, resound и ring относятся к звуку и с concerns не сочетаются.

nuance.text: Many teachers [[echoed]] her view that exams start far too early in the morning.
nuance.explanationRu: Echo — повторить чужую мысль, показывая согласие с ней. Repeat — просто сказать ещё раз, без оттенка поддержки; о чужом мнении, которое разделяют, естественнее echo.

reverse.text: Could you [[repeat]] your phone number a bit more slowly, please?
reverse.explanationRu: Сказать ещё раз то же самое, например номер телефона, — repeat. Echo используют о чужих мнениях и идеях, а не о цифрах.

fixIt.text: At the meeting, many parents [[reflected]] the head teacher's concerns about screen time.
fixIt.explanationRu: Повторить чужие опасения, соглашаясь с ними, — echo. Reflect значит «отражать» или «обдумывать»; о людях на собрании так не говорят.

reply.context: In a meeting, your manager says: "I think we should test the app with real users before the launch." A colleague asks what you think.
options: I'd echo that. Five real users will tell us more than fifty internal tests.
I'd echo that, so let's skip user testing and launch on Monday.
I hereby echo the aforementioned proposal in its entirety.
reply.explanationRu: I'd echo that — «присоединяюсь, согласен». Во втором ответе человек соглашается и тут же предлагает обратное, а третий звучит как официальный протокол.

rewrite.original: Scientists around the world repeated and supported her warning.
rewrite.frame: Her warning ____ by scientists around the world.
rewrite.explanationRu: Нужен пассив: her warning was echoed — её предупреждение повторили и поддержали.

definitionEn: connected with the relationships between living things and their environment
senseNote: Выбрано научное значение (ecological balance, ecological damage); «экологичный товар» по-английски обычно eco-friendly.
situation: Talking about the balance between plants, animals and their surroundings, and how human activity harms or protects it.

examples.text: The oil spill caused serious [[ecological]] damage to the coast, killing thousands of seabirds.
Wolves play a key [[ecological]] role by keeping deer numbers under control.
Before the dam is built, experts must assess its [[ecological]] impact on the river and the fish that live in it.

texts: Scientists warn of an [[ecological]] disaster if the lake dries up.
Cutting down the forest upset the region's [[ecological]] balance.
Bees are vital to the [[ecological]] health of farmland.

badCollocation.noteRu: Товары, безопасные для природы, обычно называют eco-friendly или green. Ecological — «связанный с экосистемами»: ecological damage, ecological balance.

collocationTask.explanationRu: Равновесие в природе — ecological balance. Eco-friendly и green описывают товары и привычки, безопасные для природы, organic — продукты без химии.

nuance.text: Scientists are studying the [[ecological]] effects of warmer water on coral reefs.
nuance.explanationRu: Ecological — связанный с экосистемами, научное слово. Eco-friendly — безвредный для природы (о товарах и привычках); последствия потепления воды так не описывают.

fixIt.text: The new motorway could cause serious [[economical]] damage to the wetlands and the birds that nest there.
fixIt.explanationRu: Economical — экономный, выгодный. Ущерб болотам и птицам — ecological damage.

wordFormation.text: The wetlands are [[ecologically]] important as a resting place for migrating birds.

definitionEn: a person whose profession is teaching or training others
senseNote: Формальное общее слово для учителей и специалистов в образовании; о своём учителе в быту говорят teacher.
situation: In formal writing about schools, universities or training, referring to people whose profession is teaching others.

examples.text: More than two thousand [[educators]] attended the conference on using technology in the classroom.
In her thirty years as an [[educator]], she taught maths in four different countries.
Parents and [[educators]] still disagree about how much homework young children should get.

texts: The new curriculum was designed by experienced [[educators]].
Many [[educators]] worry that phones distract pupils in class.
The museum offers free workshops for [[educators]] and their students.

badCollocation.noteRu: О конкретном учителе в классе говорят teacher: our teacher gave us homework. Educator — формальное слово о профессии в целом.

collocationTask.prompt: early years ___ who work in nurseries
collocationTask.explanationRu: Сотрудники детских садов в Британии — early years educators. Trainers и coaches ведут тренинги и тренировки, а educations — вообще не о людях.

nuance.text: The award is open to all [[educators]], from nursery staff to university professors.
nuance.explanationRu: Educators — общее слово для всех, кто учит: от воспитателей до профессоров. Teacher обычно значит школьного учителя, поэтому здесь оно слишком узкое.

reverse.text: My maths [[teacher]] gave me extra homework because I talked in class.
reverse.explanationRu: О конкретном учителе в школе говорят teacher. Educator звучит официально и в бытовой фразе неуместно.

fixIt.text: Hundreds of [[pedagogues]] from across the country signed an open letter about school funding.
fixIt.explanationRu: Русское «педагоги» — это educators или teachers. Pedagogue в современном английском звучит устаревше и часто насмешливо.

wordFormation.text: Every good [[educator]] knows that pupils learn as much from mistakes as from successes.

reply.context: At a job interview at a school, you are asked: "Why do you want to work with us?"
options: I've followed your work for years, and as an educator I'd love to be taught by your staff.
I've followed your work for years, and as an educator I share your focus on creativity.
Honestly, I'm an educator and your vibe is just super cool, you know?
reply.explanationRu: Educator — тот, кто учит, поэтому верен второй ответ. В первом человек хочет, чтобы учили его самого, а третий слишком разговорный для собеседования.

definitionEn: how well something works and produces the result it was intended to produce
situation: Judging whether a method, medicine or policy actually achieves the result it was designed to achieve.

examples.text: Researchers are testing the [[effectiveness]] of the new vaccine against different types of flu.
After six months, managers reviewed the [[effectiveness]] of the new training programme and decided to expand it.
Many experts question the [[effectiveness]] of long prison sentences in reducing crime.

texts: We measured the [[effectiveness]] of each advert.
Nobody doubts the [[effectiveness]] of regular exercise for mental health.
The drug's [[effectiveness]] drops if it is stored somewhere hot.

badCollocation.noteRu: Экономный расход топлива — fuel efficiency. Effectiveness говорит о том, достигается ли результат, а не о расходе ресурсов.

collocationTask.prompt: to ___ doubts about the effectiveness of the plan
collocationTask.explanationRu: Выразить сомнения — raise doubts. Rise — непереходный глагол (цены растут сами), lift — физически поднимать, grow doubts не говорят.

nuance.text: Scientists are still arguing about the [[effectiveness]] of the new drug against the disease.
nuance.explanationRu: Effectiveness — помогает ли средство вообще, достигается ли цель. Efficiency — насколько экономно расходуются время, силы или деньги; к лекарству против болезни это не подходит.

reverse.text: The new engine's fuel [[efficiency]] has cut our transport costs by a fifth.
reverse.explanationRu: Экономный расход топлива — fuel efficiency. Effectiveness говорит о результате, а не об экономии ресурсов.

fixIt.text: The survey showed that the [[effectivity]] of online lessons depends mostly on the teacher's experience.
fixIt.explanationRu: Слова effectivity в обычном английском почти нет. «Эффективность» уроков, лечения или рекламы — effectiveness.

wordFormation.text: Surveys suggest that the [[effectiveness]] of online advertising has fallen in recent years.

rewrite.original: We still don't know how well the new drug works.
rewrite.frame: The ____ the new drug is still unknown.
rewrite.explanationRu: Вместо how well it works нужно существительное: the effectiveness of.
